description: Cancel a PENDING private audio / file upload you prepared. Exact status "canceled" confirms the release; "canceling" means the release is still pending (repeat); "ready" means the asset was finalized first and stays (READY assets are never deleted). A successful cancel removes the asset and your repeat still returns "canceled" (an uploader-bound server tombstone keyed by the asset id), as does a cancel after your own rejected finalize; an unknown id, or someone else’s asset, is 404. Convergent — no idempotencyKey.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_asset_cancel
